claim: An endpoint health check monitors an endpoint that you specify either by IP address or by domain name.
question: How can you specify the endpoint of a Route 53 health check?

values.display: either by IP address or by domain name

evidence.quote: You can configure a health check that monitors an endpoint that you specify either by IP address or by domain name.

claim: At regular intervals that you specify, Route 53 submits automated requests over the internet to your application, server or other resource to verify that it is reachable, available and functional.
question: How does a Route 53 endpoint health check test a resource?

values.display: automated requests over the internet
reachable, available, and functional

evidence.quote: At regular intervals that you specify, Route 53 submits automated requests over the internet to your application, server, or other resource to verify that it's reachable, available, and functional.

claim: A calculated health check monitors whether Route 53 considers other health checks healthy or unhealthy. It can notify you only when the number of available resources drops below a threshold.
question: What does a calculated health check monitor?

values.display: monitors whether Route 53 considers other health checks healthy or unhealthy
number of available web resources drops below a specified threshold

evidence.quote: You can create a health check that monitors whether Route 53 considers other health checks healthy or unhealthy.
Then you can create a health check that monitors the status of the other health checks and that notifies you only when the number of available web resources drops below a specified threshold.

claim: You cannot configure a calculated health check to monitor the health of other calculated health checks.
question: Can a calculated health check monitor other calculated health checks?

values.display: can't configure a calculated health check to monitor the health of other calculated health checks

evidence.quote: You can't configure a calculated health check to monitor the health of other calculated health checks.

claim: A calculated health check can report healthy when at least a chosen number of the child health checks are healthy, when all of them are healthy (AND), or when one or more of them are healthy (OR).
question: How can a calculated health check decide that it is healthy?

values.display: Report healthy when at least x of y selected health checks are healthy
Report healthy when all health checks are healthy (AND)
Report healthy when one or more health checks are healthy (OR)

evidence.quote: **Report healthy when at least x of y selected health checks are healthy** – Route 53 considers this health check to be healthy when the specified number of health checks that you added to **Health checks to monitor** are healthy.

**Report healthy when all health checks are healthy (AND)** – Route 53 considers this health check to be healthy only when all the health checks that you added to **Health checks to monitor** are healthy.

**Report healthy when one or more health checks are healthy (OR)** – Route 53 considers this health check to be healthy when at least one of the health checks that you added to **Health checks to monitor** is healthy.

claim: A health check on a CloudWatch alarm monitors the same data stream that CloudWatch monitors for the alarm. Route 53 does not wait for the alarm to go into the ALARM state.
question: What does a Route 53 health check based on a CloudWatch alarm monitor?

values.display: monitors the same data stream that CloudWatch monitors for the alarm
doesn't wait for the CloudWatch alarm to go into the `ALARM` state

qualifiers.scope: health check that monitors a CloudWatch alarm

evidence.quote: After you create an alarm, you can create a health check that monitors the same data stream that CloudWatch monitors for the alarm.
To improve resiliency and availability, Route 53 doesn't wait for the CloudWatch alarm to go into the `ALARM` state.

claim: A health check can only monitor a CloudWatch alarm that exists in the same AWS account as the health check.
question: Can a Route 53 health check monitor a CloudWatch alarm from another AWS account?

values.display: exists in the same AWS account as the health check

qualifiers.scope: health check that monitors a CloudWatch alarm

evidence.quote: A health check can only monitor a CloudWatch alarm that exists in the same AWS account as the health check.

claim: Route 53 health checks support standard-resolution CloudWatch metrics. High-resolution metrics are not supported.
question: Are high-resolution CloudWatch metrics supported by Route 53 health checks?

values.display: High-resolution metrics aren't supported

qualifiers.scope: health check that monitors a CloudWatch alarm

evidence.quote: High-resolution metrics aren't supported.

claim: If the data stream does not give enough information to determine the state of the alarm, the health check status depends on the Health check status setting: healthy, unhealthy, or last known status.
question: What decides the status of an alarm-based health check when there is not enough data?

values.display: healthy, unhealthy, or last known status

qualifiers.scope: health check that monitors a CloudWatch alarm

evidence.quote: If the data stream doesn't provide enough information to determine the state of the alarm, the health check status depends on the setting for **Health check status**: healthy, unhealthy, or last known status.

claim: For an HTTP health check, Route 53 tries to establish a TCP connection and, if successful, submits an HTTP request and waits for an HTTP status code of 2xx or 3xx. An HTTPS check works the same way with an HTTPS request.
question: What response does a Route 53 HTTP health check expect from a healthy endpoint?

values.display: waits for an HTTP status code of 2xx or 3xx
Route 53 tries to establish a TCP connection

evidence.quote: **HTTP** – Route 53 tries to establish a TCP connection. If successful, Route 53 submits an HTTP request and waits for an HTTP status code of 2xx or 3xx.
**HTTPS** – Route 53 tries to establish a TCP connection. If successful, Route 53 submits an HTTPS request and waits for an HTTP status code of 2xx or 3xx.

claim: For a TCP health check, Route 53 tries to establish a TCP connection.
question: What does a Route 53 TCP health check do?

values.display: Route 53 tries to establish a TCP connection

evidence.quote: **TCP** – Route 53 tries to establish a TCP connection.

claim: HTTPS health checks do not validate SSL/TLS certificates, so checks do not fail if a certificate is invalid or expired.
question: Does a Route 53 HTTPS health check fail if the certificate is expired?

values.display: don't validate SSL/TLS certificates
don't fail if a certificate is invalid or expired

evidence.quote: HTTPS health checks don't validate SSL/TLS certificates, so checks don't fail if a certificate is invalid or expired.

claim: Route 53 cannot check the health of endpoints for which the IP address is in local, private, nonroutable, or multicast ranges.
question: Can Route 53 health checkers reach an endpoint that has only a private IP address?

values.display: IP address is in local, private, nonroutable, or multicast ranges

evidence.quote: Route 53 cannot check the health of endpoints for which the IP address is in local, private, nonroutable, or multicast ranges.

claim: After you create a health check, you cannot change its protocol.
question: Can you change the protocol of a health check after you create it?

values.display: can't change the value of **Protocol**

evidence.quote: After you create a health check, you can't change the value of **Protocol**.

claim: After you create a health check, you cannot change its request interval.
question: Can you change the request interval of a health check after you create it?

values.display: can't change the value of **Request interval**

evidence.quote: After you create a health check, you can't change the value of **Request interval**.

claim: If you specify the endpoint by domain name, Route 53 uses only IPv4 to send health checks to the endpoint.
question: Which IP version does Route 53 use for a health check that specifies the endpoint by domain name?

values.display: uses only IPv4 to send health checks

qualifiers.scope: health check with a domain name endpoint

evidence.quote: If you specify the endpoint by domain name, Route 53 uses only IPv4 to send health checks to the endpoint.

claim: If you specify the endpoint by domain name, Route 53 sends a DNS query to resolve the domain name at the request interval and then checks the health of the endpoint by using an IP address that DNS returns.
question: How does Route 53 check an endpoint that is specified by domain name?

values.display: sends a DNS query to resolve the domain name
Using an IP address that DNS returns

qualifiers.scope: health check with a domain name endpoint

evidence.quote: If you choose to specify the endpoint by domain name, Route 53 sends a DNS query to resolve the domain name that you specify in **Domain name** at the interval that you specify in **Request interval**. Using an IP address that DNS returns, Route 53 then checks the health of the endpoint.

claim: If you create a health check whose domain name matches the name of the records and associate it with those records, health check results will be unpredictable. Use the domain name of each server instead.
question: Why should the domain name of a health check differ from the record name it is attached to?

values.display: health check results will be unpredictable

qualifiers.scope: health check with a domain name endpoint

evidence.quote: In this configuration, if you create a health check for which the value of **Domain name** matches the name of the records and then associate the health check with those records, health check results will be unpredictable.

claim: With string matching, Route 53 submits an HTTP or HTTPS request and searches the response body for a specified string. If the body contains it, the endpoint is healthy; if not, or if the endpoint does not respond, it is unhealthy.
question: What is string matching in a Route 53 health check?

values.display: searching the response body for a specified string
If the response body contains the value that you specify in **Search string**

evidence.quote: Whether you want Route 53 to determine the health of an endpoint by submitting an HTTP or HTTPS request to the endpoint and searching the response body for a specified string. If the response body contains the value that you specify in **Search string**, Route 53 considers the endpoint healthy. If not, or if the endpoint doesn't respond, Route 53 considers the endpoint unhealthy.

claim: Route 53 considers case when it searches for the search string in the response body.
question: Is the search string of a Route 53 health check case sensitive?

values.display: considers case when searching

evidence.quote: Route 53 considers case when searching for **Search string** in the response body.

claim: If the web server compresses the response with an algorithm that health checkers do not support, the checker cannot decompress it before searching for the string, so the search will almost always fail.
question: What happens when the endpoint compresses its response with an unsupported algorithm?

values.display: can't decompress the response before searching for the string

evidence.quote: If the response is compressed using another algorithm, the health checker can't decompress the response before searching for the string.
